translated_title: The Daily Average of Homicides in Chiapas Has Fallen 64% Since the Start of the Current Administration
original_title: Se han reducido 64% el promedio diario de homicidios en Chiapas desde el inicio del actual gobierno: SNSP
author: Alma E. Muñoz
meta_description: High-impact crime fell 43% and vehicle theft 68%, with nearly 9,949 arrests and 18.7 tons of drugs seized across the state in under two years.
